name: PT Sinar Mas Agro Resources and Technology Tbk
summary: PT Sinar Mas Agro Resources and Technology Tbk produces and sells palm oil-based products in Indonesia. It operates through Integrated Food Consumer Products and Trading Activities, Plantations, and Other Segments. The company extracts fresh fruit bunches into crude palm oil and palm kernel, and processes into value-added products, such as cooking oil, margarine, shortening, oleochemicals, and biodiesel. It also provides cooking oil products under the Filma, Kunci Mas, Mitra, and Masku brands; industrial margarines and shortening products under the Filma, Palmboom, Menara, Palmvita and Goodfry brand names; and specialty fat products under I-soc brand.
